title: Faraday's Law - Induced EMF in a Coil
body: A coil with 200 turns has a cross-sectional area of 0.05 m^2. The magnetic field through the coil changes uniformly from 0.4 T to 0.1 T in 0.2 seconds. Calculate: (a) the change in magnetic flux through the coil, and (b) the magnitude of the induced EMF.
